result.topic_en: Supplementary results on the hypergeometric series F(α,β,γ,x): quadratic transformations, Gauss's summation formula at x=1 via the Π (factorial) function, formulas for γ=1/2 and 3/2, and the Wronskian-type relation and connection formula between the solutions P and Q.
result.transcription:
Sehr[?]

Zu den oben gelieferten Untersuchungen können wir noch folgende wichtige Nachträge liefern:

I. $(1+x)^\alpha F(\alpha,\alpha+1-\gamma,\gamma,x) = F(\tfrac12\alpha, \tfrac12\alpha+\tfrac12, \gamma, \frac{4x}{(1+x)^2})$
II. $(1+x)^{2\alpha} F(\alpha,\alpha+1-\gamma,\gamma,xx) = F(\alpha, \gamma-\tfrac12, 2\gamma-1, \frac{4x}{(1+x)^2})$
III. $F(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,1) = \frac{(\gamma-\alpha)(\gamma-\beta)}{\gamma(\gamma-\alpha-\beta)}\cdot\frac{(\gamma+1-\alpha)(\gamma+1-\beta)}{(\gamma+1)(\gamma+1-\alpha-\beta)}\cdot\frac{(\gamma+2-\alpha)(\gamma+2-\beta)}{(\gamma+2)(\gamma+2-\alpha-\beta)}$ &c.
$= \frac{\Pi(\gamma-1)\cdot\Pi(\gamma-1-\alpha-\beta)}{\Pi(\gamma-1-\alpha)\cdot\Pi(\gamma-1-\beta)}$
wenn man durch $\Pi z$ den {+Werth+} des Integrals $\int e^{-x}x^z dx$ von $x=0$ bis $x=\infty$ bezeichnet, welcher falls $z$ eine ganze Zahl ist, durch das Product $1.2.3.4\ldots z$ ausgedruckt wird.

IV. $F(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,1) = \frac{i^{\gamma-1}F(-i,\gamma-1,\gamma,1)}{i^{\gamma-1-\alpha}F(-i,\gamma-1-\alpha,\gamma-\alpha,1)}\cdot\frac{i^{\gamma-1-\alpha-\beta}F(-i,\gamma-1-\alpha-\beta,\gamma-\alpha-\beta,1)}{i^{\gamma-1-\beta}F(-i,\gamma-1-\beta,\gamma-\beta,1)}\cdot F(\alpha,\beta,i+\gamma,1)$

V. $F(\alpha,\beta,\tfrac12,x) = \mathfrak{A}(F(2\alpha,2\beta,\alpha+\beta+\tfrac12,\frac{1+\sqrt x}{2})$
$+ \mathfrak{A}\,F(2\alpha,2\beta,\alpha+\beta+\tfrac12,\frac{1-\sqrt x}{2}))$
wo $\mathfrak{A} = \frac{\Pi(-\frac12)\cdot\Pi(-\frac12-\alpha+\beta)\cdot\Pi(-\frac12+\alpha-\beta)}{\Pi(-\frac12-\alpha)\,\Pi(-\frac12-\beta)\cdot\Pi(-\frac12-\alpha-\beta)}$

VI. $F(\alpha,\beta,\tfrac32,x) = \frac{\mathfrak{B}}{\sqrt x}F(2\alpha',2\beta',\alpha+\beta-\tfrac12,\frac{1+\sqrt x}{2}) - \frac{\mathfrak{B}}{\sqrt x}F(2\alpha',2\beta',\alpha+\beta-\tfrac12,\frac{1-\sqrt x}{2})$
wo $\mathfrak{B} = \frac{2\alpha+2\beta-1}{(2\alpha-1)(2\beta-1)}\mathfrak{A}$

Es sei ferner wie oben $P = F(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,x)$, $Q = F(\alpha,\beta,\alpha+\beta+1-\gamma,1-x)$
so daß [-Kürzerem-][?]
$Q\frac{\partial P}{\partial x} - P\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} = \frac{A}{x^{\gamma}(1-x)^{\alpha+\beta+1-\gamma}}$
wo $A = \frac{\Pi[\gamma-1]\cdot\Pi(\alpha+\beta-\gamma)}{\Pi(\alpha-1)\,\Pi(\beta-1)}$
Ferner
$Q = B.P - \frac{A}{1-\gamma}\cdot x^{(1-\gamma)}F(\alpha+1-\gamma,\beta+1-\gamma,2-\gamma,x)$
wo
$B = \frac{\Pi(-\gamma)\cdot\Pi(\alpha+\beta-\gamma)}{\Pi(\alpha-\gamma)\cdot\Pi(\beta-\gamma)}$
